verdict.rationale: Raygun documents an export feature for Crash Reporting error groups and CSV exports aligned with filtered views, giving some data portability in an open format (CSV). However, there is no evidence of a comprehensive account-wide export covering APM, RUM, or all monitoring data, nor any documented process for a full account data export/deletion when leaving the platform. Missing for 10: full-account data export across all product areas (APM, RUM, deployments), documented data portability/exit process, and independent confirmation of export completeness.
